Save button "btn btn-primary btn-lg btn-block", Cancel "btn btn-secondary btn-lg btn-block". Remove inline style={{fontSize}} on inputs.

Route row: name (.row-title), delegate count (.meta with PeopleIcon), Assign button "btn btn-sm btn-primary", Edit icon btn btn-icon, Delete icon btn btn-icon. Trigger: delete icon buttons call setConfirmDelete(id) instead of handleDelete directly; handleDelete keeps its internal confirm removed.

- Error banner: .banner banner-error with Dismiss.

- Mobile-first; use sm:/lg: only to widen max-width on desktop.
